messages:
milo_sales: Quick sync — Prospect 'Sierra' wants a committed reserved plan for GA. Peak profile ~2800 RPS chat, payload mix ~68% short (~55 toks) / 32% long (~650 toks). Need AZ spread, preheat runbook, and legal-approved fallback.

parker_se: Do we have model spec? That will determine GPU footprint and memory constraints. Also confirm if sessions are sticky (KV per session).

reena_ml: They plan a 7B quantized primary and a 3B low-latency fallback. Runtime perf estimate: 7B ~1.15M tok/s/GPU, 3B ~1.9M tok/s/GPU. Avg toks/request ~0.68*55 + 0.32*650 = ~219 -> ~613k tok/s at 2800 RPS.

igor_eng: Ops margin + KV cold penalties -> recommend reserved baseline 4 GPUs across 3 AZs plus a 2-GPU burst pool (hot spare). Suggested AZ layout 2/1/1 for capacity + fault tolerance.

deploy_bot: Sim snapshot attached: 2800 RPS synthetic -> recommend reserve 4 + burst 2, expected p95 gen latency 200-280ms depending on batching/window.

parker_se: Sales needs a one-line contract clause: "Reserved GPUs: 4 baseline, 2 burst credits; preheat window 30-45m; SLA 99.9% on provisioned capacity". Can infra confirm that's deliverable?

igor_eng: Confirmed deliverable. Add autoscale policy: min_replicas=1/az, target_util=65%, scale_up when util>78% for 30s, scale_down cooloff 5m. Preheat pattern: 20% -> 50% -> 80% synthetic ramp with KV priming using customer top-300 prompts.

reena_ml: Fallback sequence recommended: 1) route long-response work to 3B in-region; 2) apply conservative truncation and reduce max_tokens; 3) route non-critical traffic to hosted multi-tenant in secondary region; 4) return lightweight failure with Retry-After header. Ensure session_compat tag so conversation state maps to 3B.

sam_security: They asked about KMS & audit for Dedicated. Paste-ready snippet: "Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure), encryption in transit & at rest, audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM or S3 with configurable retention; network isolation via VPC peering and private subnets."

milo_sales: Perfect. Next steps: Reena/Igor to finalize perf numbers + preheat checklist by EOD; Parker to draft contract line & two pricing options (reserve4+burst2 vs reserve6); Sam to insert KMS snippet into questionnaire. We'll schedule short follow-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
